title: Count claims (Python)
description: Print how many claims are in the list.

title: Standardize state codes (Python)
description: Trim whitespace and uppercase each state code.
starterCode:
states = [" ny", "CA ", "tx"]
print([s.strip().upper() for s in states])

title: Compute denial rate (Python)
description: Compute the fraction of denied claims, rounded to 2 decimals.
starterCode:
claims = ["paid", "denied", "paid", "denied"]
denied = sum(1 for c in claims if c == "denied")
print(round(denied / len(claims), 2))

title: Count claim rows (SQL)
description: Count the rows in the claims table.
starterCode: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM claims;
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE claims (id INTEGER, status TEXT);
INSERT INTO claims VALUES (1,'paid'),(2,'denied'),(3,'paid');

title: Count denied claims (SQL)
description: Count only the claims whose status is 'denied'.
starterCode: SELECT COUNT(*) AS denied FROM claims WHERE status = 'denied';
setupSql:
